description: Collect data . Sit back and evaluate #selflove #selfimprovement
transcript: am flexible but I do not settle. Experiences allow us to collect data. I collect data by allowing experiences to reveal themselves to me and in turn reveal their expectation for me in that equation. We do not have to show up as our full selves in every environment. Sometimes it's okay to take the seat back and allow environments to tell us what it is that they're expecting from us. Experiences are important because they give us background information.
